title: Summarize the board
prompt: Write two methods. public static int Total(int open, int done) returns the two counts added together. public static string Summary(int open, int done) returns text in the form "3 open, 1 done, 4 total", and gets its total by calling Total. Both methods return their result. Neither prints.
hints: What type does each method give back?
Summary can call Total(open, done) and use the result inside its text.
Return an interpolated string with open, done and Total(open, done) in braces.
checkLabels: Summary of 3 and 1 must be "3 open, 1 done, 4 total".
Summary of 0 and 0 must be "0 open, 0 done, 0 total".
Summary of 2 and 9 must be "2 open, 9 done, 11 total".

wrongAnswers.misconception: Prints the summary instead of returning it.
Works out the total as a difference.

feedback: Check that both methods return a value, and compare the text with the prompt character by character.
